documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY 27, driven by robust industry production and healthy demand across segments. Consolidated Q2 FY 27 revenue reached INR 1,556 crore, reflecting a 35% year-on-year increase, while EBITDA stood at INR 228 crore with a margin of 14.7%. The company remains confident in achieving its long-term North Star goals, including a 20% revenue CAGR through FY 31 and an absolute EBITDA target of INR 1,000 crore by FY 28. Management also highlighted strategic capex expansions, including a new Mechatronics manufacturing facility in Manesar. Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with Q2FY27 revenue growing 35% year-on-year to INR 1,556 Crore and PAT increasing 50% year-on-year to INR 117 Crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year revenue growth to be in the region of 20% compared to FY 26.
guidance.quote: However, whatever the industry has performed during the first half of the financial year and considering our H1 performance, we can expect the full-year growth to be somewhere in the region of 20%-odd, if we compare from FY 26.

guidance.claim: H2 growth is projected to be between the 15% to 20% mark on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: Getting into H2, as I mentioned, because of a higher base in FY 26, we do expect the growth for H2 to be perhaps somewhere between the 15-20% mark on a y-o-y basis.

guidance.claim: Full-year revenue growth is anticipated to be between 20% and 25%, looking at close to INR 6,000 crore.
guidance.quote: And hence, for the full year, we should be anywhere between a 20-25% growth on a full-year basis on the revenue. So, looking at perhaps close to a INR 6,000-odd crore, given that growth number.

guidance.claim: Management aims for a 20% revenue CAGR between FY 25 through FY 31.
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our 20.20.20.20 North Star, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR between FY 25 through FY 31 and inching closer to a 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

guidance.claim: By FY 31, the company aspires to more than double its current revenue base to around INR 11,000 crore.
guidance.quote: By FY 31, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to around INR 11,000 crore, fuelled by a blend of organic excellence and strategic inorganic opportunities.

guidance.claim: The effective tax rate and the share of minority interest are both expected to remain around 25% and 11% respectively going forward.
guidance.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels going forward. The share of minority interest for six months stood at 11% and is expected to be in a similar range going forward, considering the existing structure.

guidance.claim: The guidance for the full year capex continues to remain around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the effective tax rate is expected to hold at around 25% going forward.
guidance.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The share of minority interest is expected to remain between 11% and 13% going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward, this minority interest will remain in similar range between 11-13%-odd, considering the existing structure which is at the present moment.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry continued to witness healthy growth in Q2 FY 27 supported by various demand drivers.
demand_outlook.quote: Speaking of the automotive industry, the sector continued to witness a very healthy growth in Q2 FY 27, supported by improved affordability following the GST (Goods and Services Tax) 2.0, a resilient rural and urban demand, healthy freight movement, infrastructure-led activity and a gradual recovery in the replacement cycle.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is expected to moderate somewhat in H2 FY 27 as the industry moves past the lower base of H1.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we do expect growth to moderate somewhat in H2 FY 27 as the industry moves past the lower base of H1 and the full benefit of GST rate cuts gets reflected in demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is confident in posting double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in the Aftermarket segment.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are confident to bounce back and confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in this particular segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved setting up a new Mechatronics manufacturing facility at Manesar with a capital outlay of around INR 150 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: At its meeting on 24th October, 2026, the Board approved the setting up of a new Mechatronics manufacturing facility at Manesar in Haryana, with a capital outlay of around INR 150 crore to be funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The Manesar facility is expected to be commissioned in 2 phases starting Q3 FY 28 with a peak annual turnover of around INR 500 crore post-commissioning.
capex_expansion.quote: It is expected to be commissioned in 2 phases, starting Q3 FY 28, with a peak annual turnover of around INR 500 crore post-commissioning.

capex_expansion.claim: Capitalization capex for the first half of FY 27 was INR 60 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex on account of capitalization during the first quarter was INR 60 crore. [Note: The capex of INR 60 crore pertains to H1 FY 27.]

capex_expansion.claim: Guidance for full-year capex remains around INR 300 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The guidance for the year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, including the new greenfield expansion in the Mechatronics, Advanced Plastics and Alternate Fuels divisions, which is expected to begin the SOP (Start of Production) in the H2 of financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Nashik facility at Lumax Greenfuel Energy Solutions has commenced production in Q3 FY 27.
capex_expansion.quote: At Lumax Greenfuel Energy Solutions, we are pleased to report that the Nashik facility has commenced production in Q3 FY 27, the ongoing quarter, supplying ferrule-less tubes and fittings and receptacles to Mahindra & Mahindra.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant is being set up at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility will be set up in Nashik to cater to Mahindra's requirements for Greenfuel Energy.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the first quarter stood at INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY 27 EBITDA stood at INR 228 crore with a margin of 14.7%, broadly stable year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 34% y-o-y to INR 228 crore, with a margin of 14.7%, broadly stable on a y-o-y basis.

margins_costs.claim: A marginal sequential decline in margins was caused by rising input costs and recoveries from OEMs increasing revenue and denominator without immediate profit addition.
margins_costs.quote: However, on q-o-q basis, there is a marginal decline in margins, which was only due to rising input costs and its recoveries from OEMs. This means that the sales and costs has increased by a similar amounts, leading to slight dilution in margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the current margins achieved in Q1 will be sustained for the remaining part of the year.
margins_costs.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book grew to INR 1,879 crore at the end of Q2 FY 27 from INR 1,600 crore at the end of Q1 FY 27.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to the order book, it has grown to INR 1,879 crore at the end of Q2, up from INR 1,600 crore at the end of Q1 FY 27, providing a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 14% of the order book is expected to be executed in FY 27, 59% in FY 28, and 27% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 14% is expected to be executed in FY 27 itself, 59% in FY 28 and the remaining 27% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced Plastics contributes 44% of the order book, Mechatronics 27%, Alternate Fuels 20%, and Structures & Control Systems 8%.
orders_capacity.quote: Advanced Plastics continues to contribute the largest share at 44%, followed by Mechatronics at 27%, Alternate Fuels at 20% and Structures & Control Systems at 8%.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 85% of the order book consists of new business, with EV and CNG together accounting for 29%.
orders_capacity.quote: Around 85% of the order book is new business. By powertrain, EV (Electric Vehicle) and CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) together accounts for 29% of the order book, with CNG at 20% and pure EVs at about 9%, while new future technologies account for 22% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR 1,879 Crore.
The company reported a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: The Advanced Plastics division order book stands at INR 787 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 400 crore as of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of September 2026, we continue to maintain a strong balance sheet and a healthy liquidity position. Free cash reserves stood at INR 400 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 442 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.26.
capital_allocation.quote: Long-term debt stood at INR 442 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.26, which is within our internal comfort threshold.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remains challenging with ongoing conflict in the Middle East creating uncertainty across markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains challenging with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East creating uncertainty across markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input costs including crude-linked polymer prices, electronic parts costs, freight, and rupee depreciation remain key monitorables.
risks_headwinds.quote: Input costs, including crude-linked polymer prices, electronic parts costs, freight and rupee depreciation, however, remain a key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains confident of delivering the absolute EBITDA guidance of INR 1,000 crore for FY 28.
management_commitments.quote: Having said that, I think we remain quite confident for the remaining part of FY 27, and we are quite confident of delivering the absolute guidance of EBITDA for FY 28, which was always at about INR 1,000 crore EBITDA. We remain quite confident to achieve that in FY 28.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach approximately INR 11,000 Crore in revenue by FY31e.
management_commitments.quote: FY31e revenue of ~INR 11,000 Cr includes ~INR 8,500 Cr organic; growth from FY25 base of INR 3,637 Cr

management_commitments.claim: By FY 2031, management aspires to more than double the current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore.
management_commitments.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to a 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.
management_commitments.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
